findings.title: ‘Kind of heartbreaking’: Mass General Brigham to close its only primary care clinic in Downtown Crossing
findings.exact_supporting_passage: MGH Downtown Associates will be closing on Dec. 18, Jessica Pastore, a spokesperson for MGB, confirmed on Wednesday.
findings.service_line: Primary care (MGH Downtown Associates, 294 Washington St., Downtown Crossing)
findings.access_consequences: The Downtown Crossing practice is scheduled to close December 18, 2026, removing this neighborhood practice site. Six providers and most staff are reportedly being offered positions at other MGB-affiliated practices, but individual patient continuity and placement were not confirmed. This is a confirmed scheduled loss of the site, not a currently effective shutdown.
findings.affected_population: Existing MGH Downtown Associates primary-care patients; a clinic employee estimated approximately 8,000–10,000 patients, unverified by the operator.
